paite: Thil hoih lou hihte ziak in kihihlungkham nuam dah inla, dikloutak a hihte leng eng ke'n.
heading: David La / Kuhkal Leh Muang Ding A Hanthawnna

paite: Loupa bang in atpaih in a-om zok ding ua, louhing bang a vuai ding ahi ngal ua.
TOUPA muang inla, thil hoih hih in; hiai gam ah om inla, ginomna delh zel in.
TOUPA tung ah leng kipak in; huchi in na lungtang deihlamte ahon pe ding hi.
Na omdan ding TOUPA tung ah nga inla; amah muang in, ama'n ahih vek ding.
Na dikdan vak bang in asuaksak ding a, na siamtandan leng sun lai bang mai in.
TOUPA ah khawl inla, amah ngak nilouh in; a-omdan a vangphatna mute ziak in kihihlungkham nuam dah in, ngaihtuahna giloute pichin mi ziak in.
Heh tawpsan inla, thangpaih kisik in; kihihlungkham nuam ke'n, thilhihkhelh ah ahong ke maimah nak hi.
Thil hoih lou hihte hihmang in a-om dek ngal ua; TOUPA ngakte'n bel gam aluah ding uhi.
Sawt louchik in migilou-salou a-om nawnta kei dia; ahi, a-omna mun uh enen mah lechin, a-omta kei ding hi.
Thunuailutte'n gam aluah ding ua; kituahna thupitak ah akipak ding uhi.
Migilou-salou in midiktat a sawm a, aha agawikhum nak hi.
Toupa'n amah anuihsan ding. Ani hong tung dek ahi chih atheih ziak in.
Genthei leh tagahte hihpuk ding leh omdan dikte that ding in migilou-saloute'n namsau aphawi ua, athalpeute uh alai uhi.
Anamsau un amau lungtang asun ding a, thalpeute uh hihtan in a-om ding hi.
Midiktat thil tawmchik neih migilou-salou thil neih keihkuih sang in ahoihzaw ahi.
Migilou-salou bante hihtan in a-om dek ngal a, TOUPA'N midik alen gige ding ahi.
TOUPA'N mihoihkimte nite athei a; agouluah ding uh tangtawn a om gige ding ahi.
Hun hoih lou ah azahlak kei ding ua; kial kum in leng avah ding uhi.
Migilou-saloute amangthang ding ua, TOUPA doute leng gamlak loupa pak kilawm bang in hihmanthat in a-om ding ua, meikhu in azammang ding uhi.
Migilou-salou in aleitawi a, ape nawn kei nak a; midik in bel zahngaihna suah in, ape zaw nak hi.
Avualzawlna mute'n gam aluah ding ua, ahamsiatte hihmanthat in a-om ding uhi.
Mi kalsuante TOUPA hihkip ahi a; alampi ah akipak nak hi.
Puk mahleh, lupdetsak in zaw a-om kei ding hi; TOUPA'N akhut in alen gige ngal a.
Naupang ka na hita a, tu in tek ka hong hita, himahleh midiktat limsak louh a a-om lam ka mu ngei kei hi, asuante an ngolh lam leng ka mu ngei sam kei hi.
Mi ahehpih gige a, aleitawisak a; asuante leng ahampha nak uhi.
Gilou paisan inla, thil hoih hih in; huchi in tangtawn in teng gige in.
TOUPA'N vaihawm diktat adeih ngal a, amisiangthoute apaisan ngei kei hi, tangtawn a ding in kephoih in a-om ua; migilou-salou suante bel hihmang in a-om ding uhi.
Midikte'n gam aluah ding ua, asung ah tangtawn in a-om ding uh.
Midik kam in pilna thu agen a, alei in vaihawm diktatna thu agen hi.
A Pathian dan alungtang ah a-om a; akalsuan atolh kei ding hi.
Migilou-salou in midiktat a-enkhia a, hihlup atum gige hi.
TOUPA'N akhut ah anuse kei ding a, avaihawm hun chiang in siam louh tansak aphal sam kei ding hi.
TOUPA ngak inla, alampi tawn in, huchi in gam luah ding in ahon pahtawi ding hi; migilou-saloute hihmanthat a a-om uh na mu ding hi.
Migilou-salou nakpitak a thu nei a, apouna mun a singnou dawng thenthon bang a, ka biambuam ka mu hi.
Himahleh lampi ah mi ava pai ua, ngai dih, amah ana om kei maimah a; ahi, ka zong a, himahleh muh theih ahita kei hi.
Migensiatbei chiamteh inla, midiktak en in, huchibang mite tawpna ding zaw khamuanna hi ding ahi ngal a.
Talekte bel akituak a hihsiat in a-om ding ua, migilou-salou tawpna ding tuh hihmanthat ahita ding hi.
Himahleh midiktatte hotdamna TOUPA a kipan in ahi; amah mangbat lai a kulhpi muan ahi.
TOUPA'N amaute panpih in ahumbit a, amah ah akituklut ziak un migilou-saloute lak ah humbit in ahondam hi.
